config.label: Bearer token (mz_oauth_* or mz_*) that unlocks the hosted plane on mockzilla
config.description: Bearer token (mz_oauth_* or mz_*) that unlocks the hosted plane on mockzilla.org. Leave unset to use only the local plane.

config.label: Override the hosted MCP endpoint (staging or self-hosted)
config.description: Override the hosted MCP endpoint (staging or self-hosted). Defaults to https://platform.mockzilla.org/mcp/.

config.label: Preferred port for the local managed mock server
config.description: Preferred port for the local managed mock server. Defaults to 2200; falls back to a kernel-picked port if busy.
